title: Workflow hardening gate with negative fixtures
summary: Adds `tests/Arch/WorkflowHardening.php` (pure checker of rules W1–W10) and `tests/Arch/WorkflowHardeningTest.php` asserting zero violations over `.github/workflows/*.yml`, one failing fixture per rule under `tests/Arch/Fixtures/Workflows/`, and the zizmor allowlist comment/expiry rule.
why: P0-B: the hardening must not regress silently; the audit requires a parser gate whose negative fixtures (`actions/checkout@v6`, `zizmor ... || true`) fail it. Risk: a checker that only scans parsed YAML misses version comments (W1) and multi-line shell shape (W9) — scan raw text for those.

include: `tests/Arch/WorkflowHardeningTest.php`: real-tree test, ten fixture tests (dataset), allowlist test with an expired and an unannotated synthetic entry
Allowlists W2/W6 as PHP constants mirroring knowledge/supply-chain#gate and #permissions
exclude: Workflow behavior changes (only if the gate finds a missed violation: fix the workflow in this item)

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence
Style: YAML parsing, `releaseTriggers()` for the `on` key
How helper files are loaded from Arch tests

rules: Each fixture is a complete workflow that violates exactly one rule; the test asserts the rule id set equals `[<rule>]`.
guidance: Use `Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml::parse($raw)`. W9 multi-line detection: a `run` string containing a newline after trimming. W1 raw scan: regex per line `^\s*(-\s*)?uses:\s*(\S+)(.*)$`, skip values starting with `./`. Pint and Rector must accept the new PHP files (`composer lint:check`, `composer refactor:check`).

result.notes: W1-W10 checker, 15 tests (real tree clean, 10 fixtures, allowlist/expiry rules); W1 допускает комментарий версии без v
